column2: Whew, that was a hard fight!
We are sorry... The volunteer soldiers got carried away by their $$血$$,
so... what should we do now?!
It seems the people of Gomorrah have no intention of reporting anything to the $$異端審問会$$ for now!
On the contrary, this city's conspicuous actions and black smoke
have them worried that the $$異端審問会$$ may learn of us.
Do not think only of making your city bigger.
Consider harmony with your surroundings and nature, and restrain yourselves from now on!!
I want you to think about those who can no longer work, too.
Now that you say it, perhaps we have been too hasty.
We will reconsider it with everyone in the city.
